```artifact
Feature: Embedded Controller Functionality

  Scenario: Controller Responds Fast Enough to Prevent Pressure Dropping Below -4cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the pressure drops below -4cm
    Then the controller responds within 1 second to prevent pressure dropping below -4cm

  Scenario: Controller Never Commands Pressure Above 60
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the commanded pressure is above 60
    Then the controller does not command pressure above 60

  Scenario: SW Measures PEEP Over Each Breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a breath is taken
    Then the controller measures PEEP over each breath

  Scenario: Controller Hits Commanded Values Within 10%
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a parameter is commanded
    Then the controller hits commanded values within 10%

  Scenario: Controller Triggers Inspiration Cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the inspiratory pressure is reached
    Then the controller triggers an inspiration cycle

  Scenario: Controller Triggers Expiration Cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the expiratory pressure is reached
    Then the controller triggers an expiration cycle

  Scenario: Controller Meets PIP Targets in Range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the PIP target is set to a value in the range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm
    Then the controller meets PIP targets in the range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm

  Scenario: Controller Meets Commanded Breath Rate Within +- 1 Breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the commanded breath rate is set
    Then the controller meets commanded breath rate within +- 1 breath

  Scenario Outline: Controller Performance Targets
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the performance target is set to <target>
    Then the controller meets the performance target

    Examples:
      | target    |
      | 10%       |
      | 5%        |
      | 15%       |
      | 20%       |
      | 25%       |

  Scenario Outline: Controller Pressure Limits
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the pressure is set to <pressure>
    Then the controller responds accordingly

    Examples:
      | pressure  |
      | -4cm      |
      | 60        |
      | 61        |
      | -5cm      |
```
